perso.name: Personalization (1:1)

agentic.gloss: Systems that don't just generate, they decide and act toward a goal.

decis.name: Agentic decisioning
decis.gloss: An agent choosing what to say, when, how often and on which channel — per person.

bandit.name: Bandits / RL
bandit.gloss: The maths that lets a system learn which choice wins by trying and measuring.

cep.name: CEP
cep.gloss: Customer Engagement Platform — where this messaging actually runs.

geo.name: GEO
geo.gloss: Generative Engine Optimization — being visible inside AI answers.

govern.name: Governance
govern.gloss: The controls that make automated decisions safe, explainable and legible.

stories.head: Braze CTO Jon Hyman on keeping humans on the campaign launch button as AI runs decisioning
stories.plain: Braze's CTO explains how Decisioning Studio Go and Operator Connect shift campaign execution to AI agents while keeping a human approval step at launch. This is a rare frank account from a major CEP vendor on where the automation boundary sits — directly relevant to anyone buying or governing marketing AI today.

stories.head: Constructor launches Agentic Checkout with Stripe, letting AI agents complete purchases end-to-end
stories.plain: Constructor has wired Stripe directly into its product-discovery AI agent so shoppers — or autonomous shopping bots — can go from search to payment without leaving the agent experience. This is an early live example of agentic commerce infrastructure, shifting how retailers need to think about the buyer journey and checkout conversion.

stories.head: DV launches attribution measurement and brand-suitability pilots for ChatGPT ads
stories.plain: DoubleVerify now lets advertisers measure campaign impact inside ChatGPT and is piloting brand-safety controls for conversational ad placements. As ad budgets flow into AI chat environments, this sets early standards for how measurement and brand governance will work — changing what marketers should demand from ad verification vendors.

stories.head: AI local-search usage surges 6X, pushing consumers into a multi-platform verification loop
stories.plain: SOCi research shows AI-powered local search has grown sixfold, fragmenting discovery across many platforms and forcing consumers to cross-check answers before acting. This signals that local brands must now optimise for AI answer surfaces, not just Google Maps, fundamentally reshaping local marketing strategy and spend.

stories.head: Ahrefs 2026 survey: 24% of marketers now say AI content is higher quality; 'trust but verify' dominates
stories.plain: Ahrefs surveyed content marketers and found AI-generated content quality perceptions are rising fast while human-written content quality is seen as falling. The dominant workflow is still human review of AI output, but the gap is closing — useful benchmark data for anyone deciding how to staff or automate a content operation.

stories.head: Braze CTO explains why the campaign launch button stays human as AI runs decisioning
stories.plain: Braze's CTO Jon Hyman discusses Decisioning Studio Go and Operator Connect, explaining why Braze deliberately keeps a human approval step before campaigns fire. This is a rare public statement from a major CEP vendor on AI governance philosophy — directly shaping how enterprise buyers think about risk, control, and accountability when buying agentic marketing tools.

stories.head: Braze expands AI from content creation into full campaign operations
stories.plain: Braze rolled out tools that let AI handle decisioning, automated campaign quality checks, and connections to external LLMs like Claude — moving well beyond copy generation. This shifts Braze from a messaging tool into an agentic campaign operations layer, which changes procurement conversations for any brand evaluating enterprise CEPs.

stories.head: Constructor launches Agentic Checkout with Stripe, taking shoppers from discovery to purchase inside one AI agent
stories.plain: Constructor wired Stripe payments directly into its AI product-discovery agent so shoppers — or autonomous shopping bots — can complete a purchase without leaving the agent experience. This is a concrete example of agentic commerce collapsing the funnel, and it signals how retailers will need to rethink conversion infrastructure and attribution.

stories.head: DV launches attribution measurement and brand-suitability pilots for ChatGPT ads
stories.plain: DoubleVerify now lets advertisers measure campaign impact inside ChatGPT and is piloting brand-risk controls for conversational ad placements. As ad budgets follow audiences into AI chat interfaces, verification and suitability standards for generative ad environments become a must-have — this is the first major measurement framework built specifically for that context.

stories.head: Salesforce acquires AI customer research startup Listen Labs
stories.plain: Salesforce bought Listen Labs, whose technology conducts AI-powered customer interviews, analyzes responses, and simulates buyer behavior. Plugging that capability into Salesforce's CRM and agent layer means real-time customer insight could feed directly into agentic decisioning — tightening the loop between understanding customers and acting on that understanding automatically.

month.skicker: 30-day synthesis · the shape underneath the feed

themes.head: AI Search Is Rewriting Discovery Rules
body: AI-powered search has surged 6× for local queries in a single year, fragmenting the ecosystem that Google long dominated. Brands optimizing only for traditional SERPs are now invisible in the channels where buying decisions are actually forming — a structural shift, not a trend.

A wave of new tools — from Contentpen 2.0 tracking visibility across seven AI engines to IA SEO Monitor Premium — signals that 'Answer Engine Optimization' (AEO) is becoming a distinct discipline. Marketers must now engineer content to be cited, not just ranked, across generative surfaces.
ev: Agile Brand · From Found to Cited

themes.head: Agentic Commerce Collapses the Funnel
body: Constructor's agentic checkout — powered by Stripe — lets shoppers move from product discovery to purchase inside a single AI agent session, eliminating every traditional funnel stage in between. This is not an incremental UX improvement; it removes the browse-to-cart journey that most conversion strategies are built around.

Simultaneously, followOS-email and Braze's expansion into campaign operations show agents taking over not just customer-facing tasks but internal marketing workflows. GTM teams are already struggling to track their AI agents, meaning governance and orchestration are now as urgent as adoption.
ev: MarTech · GTM teams losing track of AI agents
MarTech · Braze expands AI to campaign ops

themes.head: Speed Without Quality Is a Content Debt Crisis
body: AI has made content production dramatically faster, but the Ahrefs 'trust but verify' research and the blunt headline 'AI made marketing faster than it made marketing better' confirm that velocity without governance is accumulating a content debt that now carries compounding interest. Low-quality output is harder to clean up at scale than it was to create.

Brands ignoring this debt face a double penalty: degraded generative-search citations (AI engines cite authoritative, accurate content) and eroding customer trust as audiences grow more demanding and less forgiving. Structured content audits and human editorial checkpoints are re-emerging as strategic assets, not overhead.
ev: MarTech · AI made marketing faster not better
MarTech Series · Ahrefs Trust but Verify

themes.head: Measurement & Attribution Enter the AI Ad Era
body: DoubleVerify launching attribution measurement and brand suitability tooling specifically for ChatGPT ads marks a turning point: AI-native ad inventory is now large enough to need the same accountability infrastructure that display and video built over a decade. Advertisers can no longer treat these placements as experimental if DV is building measurement rails for them.

At the same time, Salesforce acquiring Listen Labs for AI-powered customer research and the industry's ongoing 'evidence problem' in B2B ROI show that the demand for closed-loop proof is intensifying across the stack. Attribution is moving from a reporting function to a real-time decision input for AI-run campaigns.

themes.head: Human Judgment as the Last Strategic Moat
body: Braze CTO Jon Hyman's argument that the launch button must stay human crystallizes a wider industry reckoning: as AI automates execution, the scarce resource is the marketer who can set intent, evaluate risk, and take accountability. Job-posting data confirms employers are now explicitly hiring for AI-oversight skills alongside prompt fluency.

The parallel conversation about saving early-career roles through apprenticeships reveals the structural risk underneath — if junior tasks are automated away, the pipeline that produces senior judgment dries up. Organizations that treat AI as a headcount replacement rather than a capability multiplier are eroding the very human judgment that makes AI deployments safe and effective.

month.takeaway: Across every layer of the stack — search, commerce, content, measurement, and talent — AI is shifting the competitive advantage from those who produce fastest to those who govern most deliberately.
